objections.text: The viewer's GET /api/servers/<id>/names follows every page of the server's list in one answer: a list with no limit at the proxy. The spec caps it at 1,000 names; the server's pages stay bounded.
Forget name is a hard delete of an alias row behind a button: the row is the only thing deleted, it is refused while a level is bound to the name, and it is logged.
Any member can create names with no cap on the registry's size: the devices bucket bounds the rate; an admin's deletion of a name is a later item.
